LESSON: SARUFI 8.4.1 NGELI NA UPATANISHO WA KISARUFI NGELI YA

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: Strand 8
Topic 8.4: Sarufi 8.4.1 Ngeli na Upatanisho wa Kisarufi Ngeli ya

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Sarufi 8.4.1 Ngeli na Upatanisho wa Kisarufi Ngeli ya. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kutambua viambishi vya upatanisho wa kisarufi vya ngeli ya sentensi
2. kutambua nomino za ngeli ya U-ZI na
3. kutumia nomino za ngeli ya U-ZI na kwa kuzingatia upatanisho ufaao wa kisarufi

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kutambua viambishi vya upatanisho wa kisarufi vya ngeli ya sentensi
   In simple words: practise until you can kutambua viambishi vya upatanisho wa kisarufi vya ngeli ya sentensi. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kutambua nomino za ngeli ya U-ZI na
   In simple words: practise until you can kutambua nomino za ngeli ya U-ZI na. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. kutumia nomino za ngeli ya U-ZI na kwa kuzingatia upatanisho ufaao wa kisarufi
   In simple words: practise until you can kutumia nomino za ngeli ya U-ZI na kwa kuzingatia upatanisho ufaao wa kisarufi. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Sarufi 8.4.1 Ngeli na Upatanisho wa Kisarufi Ngeli ya using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Sarufi 8.4.1 Ngeli na Upatanisho wa Kisarufi Ngeli ya in the examples.
2. Explain Sarufi 8.4.1 Ngeli na Upatanisho wa Kisarufi Ngeli ya to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Sarufi 8.4.1 Ngeli na Upatanisho wa Kisarufi Ngeli ya.
4. Show that you can: kutambua viambishi vya upatanisho wa kisarufi vya ngeli ya sentensi

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Sarufi 8.4.1 Ngeli na Upatanisho wa Kisarufi Ngeli ya using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Sarufi 8.4.1 Ngeli na Upatanisho wa Kisarufi Ngeli ya important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kutambua viambishi vya upatanisho wa kisarufi vya ngeli ya sentensi
2. kutambua nomino za ngeli ya U-ZI na
3. kutumia nomino za ngeli ya U-ZI na kwa kuzingatia upatanisho ufaao wa kisarufi

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
